title: Fig. 21: Gemini Parachute Landing Sequence diagram with Table IV GT-4 consumables
description: Vertical sequence diagram titled "GEMINI PARACHUTE LANDING SEQUENCE" showing the spacecraft descending through drogue chute deployment, pilot and main parachute deployment, two-point suspension, touchdown and jettison of the main chute, with altitude marks at left. The upper half of the page is "TABLE IV GT-4 CONSUMABLE LOADINGS" listing batteries, propellants, oxygen, lithium hydroxide, food and water. Text notes that the crew could eject and use personal parachutes if the 84-foot main parachute failed.
